title: The exceptional adjoint on the bounded comparison class
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p_0$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p_0$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$ of its valuation ring, and an integer $n\geq1$. Put $A=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n\mathcal O_E$, a finite discrete commutative ring [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type $k$-morphism [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix a compactification $c=(j,p)$, $X\xrightarrow{j}\overline X\xrightarrow{p}Y$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], with $\dim\overline X\leq d$ for an integer $d\geq0$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension].

Use ordinary constant-$A$ module sheaves and their derived categories on the small étale and pro-étale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Write $\nu_T:T_{\mathrm{proet}}\to T_{\mathrm{et}}$ for the comparison morphism [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism] and $\nu_T^*$ for its exact derived pullback [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback]. Write $F_c=Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}j_!^{\mathrm{et}}$ for ordinary étale compact support [def-amb-etale-compact-support] and $P_c=Rf_{!,n}^c=Rp_*j_!$ for pro-étale compact support at this compactification [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]. Then:

1. The class-restricted datum [def-sf-fullcd-class] holds for the proper part $p$ with bound $2d$: $\operatorname{FullCD}_{\mathrm{cls}}(p,A;2d)$.
2. The functor $F_c$ has a right adjoint $f_c^\times$ on the ordinary étale derived categories. The composite
$$R_cL=\nu_X^*f_c^\times R\nu_{Y,*}L$$
takes bounded-below pro-étale complexes to bounded-below pro-étale complexes. For every bounded-below $K$ of étale origin, meaning there exist $G\in D^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $\alpha:\nu_X^*G\xrightarrow{\sim}K$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], and every $L\in D^+(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, there is a natural bijection
$$\operatorname{Hom}(P_cK,L)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(K,R_cL).$$
It is independent of the choice of étale-origin witness. Thus $R_c$ is the right adjoint relative to this bounded-below comparison class. This applies in particular to the bounded constructible inputs [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility] used here.
3. The compactification comparisons of these functors on the stated domains are canonical and satisfy the cocycle condition; the Hom bijections respect these comparisons.

No adjunction on arbitrary unbounded pro-étale objects is asserted.

proof.text: The coefficient ring A is finite by [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. The given compactification c supplies HasCompactification f. Quasi-compactness of the given structure map aY to Spec k gives CompactSpace Y. Use the ordinary etale exceptional adjunction of [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint], implemented by Etale.rightDerivedUpperShriekAdjunction. Transport its left functor to the literal supplied c by the unbounded canonical comparison Etale.rightDerivedLowerShriekIso from [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Thus G may be chosen as the existing ordinary rightDerivedUpperShriek, and adj is its adjunction transported by ofNatIsoLeft. Neither an arbitrary Hom equivalence nor an identification of the opaque chosen compactification with c is used.

source.place: Ordinary etale right adjoint used in the displayed chain.

proof.text: Prove clause (1), the two conjuncts of [def-sf-fullcd-class], by the comparison argument of [thm-sf-fullcd-class]. Its published theorem carries an unused invertible-exponent hypothesis, so use its underlying Etale.isZero_higherDirectImage_of_isPullback_of_isProper directly. For an arbitrary pullback of the proper part and an etale-origin sheaf M, choose an etale sheaf M0 and its isomorphism to M. The higher direct image of M0 vanishes in degrees r > 2d by that theorem. Exact comparison inverse image preserves the zero object. Transport its homology along the single-functor isomorphism of the chosen origin, rightDerivedLowerStarComparisonIso', and mapDerivedCategoryHomologyFunctorIso. This proves the vanishing for M on every such pullback. The identity square gives the first conjunct; etaleOrigin_upperStar_obj supplies the origin of the restricted sheaf in the second conjunct. This includes arbitrary pro-etale base changes and uses no invertible-exponent witness.

The existing quasi-compact-target theorem [lem-etale-upper-shriek-quasicompact-bounded-below] already derives finite amplitude and its orthogonality consequence. Apply Etale.plus_rightDerivedUpperShriek_obj to G. Derived comparison direct image sends a bounded-below input L to a bounded-below etale object, by rightDerivedFunctorPlusCompatibility and the bounded-below derived functor. Therefore H_L = G Rnu_Y,* L is bounded below. Exact comparison inverse image [def-sf-comparison-derived-pullback] preserves that lower bound, so nu_X^* H_L is bounded below. For the current separately specified right adjoint, compare its adjunction to adj of Step 1 using rightAdjointUniq and transport this same object property along the resulting isomorphism. For the retained existence theorem G is selected as in Step 1, and that last transport is unnecessary.

source.place: Finite amplitude and bounded-below preservation before the Hom chain.

proof.text: For a bounded-below etale representative K0, compose the following explicit Hom bijections: fixedCompactSupportComparisonIso of [lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison], the comparison adjunction of [thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison], adj of Step 1, and the map of comparison inverse image on Hom sets. The last map is bijective by comparison full faithfulness because H_L is bounded below by Step 3. In Lean this is representativeHomEquiv. Naturality follows by the inverse compact-support comparison naturality equation, the two adjunction homEquiv_naturality equations, and functoriality of comparison. For the current primary interface, additionally conjugate by the retained origin witness isomorphism, exactly as specifiedExceptionalHomEquiv does.

source.place: Displayed Hom chain and the following full-faithfulness sentence.

proof.text: Lift bounded-below etale comparison to the full subcategory plusEtaleOrigin. Its fullness and faithfulness are precisely the comparison Hom bijection; essential surjectivity unpacks the origin property [def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness]. Thus comparisonOriginLift is an equivalence. Transport the explicit Hom equivalences of Step 4 through its representative isomorphisms. To prove naturality in the source, lift the conjugate of a source morphism through the equivalence and apply representative naturality; naturality in the target commutes with the same transports. On an object literally in the image, representative naturality and cancellation show that the descended bijection equals the original bijection. These are comparisonHomDescent_left, comparisonHomDescent_right and comparisonHomDescent_obj. Hence the result is independent of the choice of witness and has the prescribed normalization. The only representative choices are those of an established equivalence, determined up to the isomorphisms used by the transport.

source.place: Naturality and independence of the witness.

proof.text: For compactifications c,d, transport the canonical etale comparison of [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons] by fixedCompactSupportComparisonIso at c and d, obtaining exactly fixedCompactSupportOriginIso on every etale representative. Fully faithful whiskering by comparisonOriginLift descends this isomorphism to the origin subcategory: this is originComparison. The map_preimage equation proves its prescribed normalization. The etale cocycle gives the cocycle on representatives after cancelling the adjacent inverse compact-support comparisons. Faithfulness then gives originComparison_trans on the whole origin subcategory, and cancellation in its c=c=d instance gives originComparison_refl.

Normalize every right functor in the retained interface to nu_X^* G Rnu_Y,*. For every compactification c define its Hom bijection by first precomposing with the inverse of originComparison c c0 and then using the descended bijection at c0. Source and target naturality follow from Step 5 and naturality of originComparison. The normalization equation follows from originComparison_refl and comparisonHomDescent_obj, followed by cancellation of the two adjunction bijections and the compact-support isomorphism. To compare c and d, use the inverse component of the cocycle originComparison c d c0 and cancel originComparison c d against its inverse. This proves comparison_homEquiv; the right comparison is the identity because all right functors have been normalized to the same G. Together with Step 3 these are exactly the fields of buildFixedComparisonClassAdjunction. Combining that structure with Step 2 proves exists_fixedComparisonClassAdjunction. For any separately selected ordinary adjoints, uniqueness of right adjoints transports this normalized description to theirs, preserving the specified Hom chain.

source.place: The final sentence, implemented with a single normalized ordinary right adjoint.

proof.text: The bounded constructible application in the natural-language statement follows from [lem-sf-proetale-constructible-origin]: such an input has a bounded-below etale representative, so it belongs to the same origin class. This application is not an extra field or a strengthened input restriction in the retained existence theorem; no constructibility hypothesis enters any preceding step.

source.place: Application to the bounded constructible inputs of the unit.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be separated of finite type over $\Fbar$, with a
compactification of dimension at most $d$, and let $A=A_{E,n}$.
Then the following statements hold:

1. The class-restricted dimension datum
[def-sf-fullcd-class] holds with bound $2d$.
1. Let $f^\times$ be the right adjoint of the étale
compact-support functor. On bounded-below pro-étale coefficients put
$$
Rf_n^\times L=\nu_X^* f^\times R\nu_{Y,*}L.
$$
For every bounded-below $K$ of étale origin and every bounded-below
$L$, there is a natural bijection
$$
\operatorname{Hom}(Rf_{!,n}K,L)
\cong\operatorname{Hom}(K,Rf_n^\times L).
$$
Thus this formula is the right adjoint relative to the bounded-below
comparison class.
1. Compactification comparisons of these functors are canonical and
satisfy the cocycle condition.

No adjunction on arbitrary unbounded pro-étale objects is asserted.

proof.text:
Clause (1) is [thm-sf-fullcd-class]. Write $K=\nu_X^*G$ with
$G$ bounded below. The finite cohomological dimension of compact
support implies that its right adjoint $f^\times$ takes bounded-below
objects to bounded-below objects: a bound
$Rf_!D^{\leq0}\subseteq D^{\leq N}$ gives
$f^\times D^{\geq0}\subseteq D^{\geq-N}$ by adjunction and
orthogonality. Hence all étale objects in the following comparison
are in the domain of the fully faithful functor of
[thm-weil-pbc-site-comparison]. Using
[lem-sf-class-compact-support-comparison] and the adjoint of
[thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint] gives

$$
\operatorname{Hom}(Rf_{!,n}\nu_X^*G,L)
\cong\operatorname{Hom}(Rf_!^{\Et}G,R\nu_{Y,*}L)
\cong\operatorname{Hom}(G,f^\times R\nu_{Y,*}L)
\cong\operatorname{Hom}(\nu_X^*G,\nu_X^*f^\times R\nu_{Y,*}L).
$$

The last step is full faithfulness, not an adjunction with a second
$R\nu_{X,*}$; the latter would have the wrong source category.
The bijection is natural and independent of the witness. The coherent
compactification comparisons follow by applying the fixed functors
$\nu_X^*$ and $R\nu_{Y,*}$ to the étale comparisons of
[lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons] and using uniqueness of the
étale right adjoints. This proves (2) and (3).
